game_title: Code Reading Relay – Bazaar Tents Trial
game_concept: A puzzle set in Sand Dunes – Bazaar Tents, a tented desert bazaar: the oasis keeper must handle giant scorpions while practicing debugging & combined skills. Core idea – Code Reading Relay: Read short programs as a relay and predict their output line by line.
theme: Sand Dunes – Bazaar Tents: a tented desert bazaar
core_gameplay_loop: In Bazaar Tents, repeat each round: Read short programs as a relay and predict their output line by line. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the predicted value and advance.
player_objective: Reach the sandstone arch using at most 11 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
win_condition: The sandstone arch reached with actions_used <= 11.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 11 before the sandstone arch is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 9 – Debugging & Combined Skills | Level 3 (intro tier): Code Reading Relay
assets_style: sun-baked pixel-art desert: golden dunes, tall cacti, a bright blue oasis, warm orange shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Code Reading Relay' (Week 9 slot 10), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Bazaar Tents'. tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how predicted changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against giant scorpions in Bazaar Tents.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The sandstone arch reached with actions_used <= 11.
